custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active tracked part, part A, at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425684-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425684-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • The fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Part Status (Active / Inactive), Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Average Cost, Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch "Track quantities and cost of goods", then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (the bin rows, then "Add Bin Location").
  • "Add Bin Location" has a plus icon before its label.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-R4: “The fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Part Status (editing only), Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Average Cost (editing) or Cost (creating), Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch, then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (bin locations, then "Add Bin Location").”
  • S13-R5: “"Add Bin Location" has a plus icon before its label.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
